RouteMarker.PreviewDescription: CONSUMABLE · 3 stored markers. Your team sees them; at most 3 of yours remain placed. Placed markers disappear when the round ends.
RouteMarker.Name: Route Marker Pack
RouteMarker.Description: Costs 2 Research Tokens for 3 markers. Place one to point a direction your whole team can see. Up to 3 of yours stand at a time, and they are cleared when the round ends.

SpeedPotion.PreviewDescription: CONSUMABLE · 1 stored potion. +30% movement speed for 6s. One use per round. No stamina change.
SpeedPotion.Name: Speed Potion
SpeedPotion.Description: Costs 3 Research Tokens. Drink it during a run to move 30% faster for 6 seconds. One per round, it does not stack, and it changes nothing about your stamina.

EmergencyReentry.Name: Emergency Re-entry
EmergencyReentry.Description: Adds 1 stored Emergency Re-entry credit. Return to your death location with 10 seconds invisible to monsters. Unsafe locations use nearby safe ground. Once per round.

Tokens20.Name: 20 Research Tokens
Tokens20.Description: Adds 20 Research Tokens to your account. Spend tokens on permanent +5% Stamina or Battery upgrades, or buy one Entity Shield charge for 5 tokens.

ExpeditionPack.Description: Consumable pack: 1 stored Emergency Re-entry, 1 Entity Shield charge and 3 Route Markers. Use re-entry after dying; activate shield and markers from Equipment during a run. Repeatable purchase, not a permanent pass.
ExpeditionPack.PreviewDescription: CONSUMABLE · 1 re-entry after death (10s protection), 1 shield charge (5s), 3 route markers. Stored until used. Repeatable purchase.
ExpeditionPack.Name: Expedition Pack

Tokens4.Name: 4 Research Tokens
Tokens4.Description: Adds 4 Research Tokens to your account. Spend tokens on permanent +5% Stamina or Battery upgrades, or buy one Entity Shield charge for 5 tokens.

AdvancedEquipment.PreviewDescription: PERMANENT · Focused torch (+45% range, same drain), +50% base stamina, hazmat colors and one +5% stamina/battery upgrade. Demo includes colors.
AdvancedEquipment.Name: Advanced Equipment
AdvancedEquipment.Description: Permanent focused flashlight: a narrower beam with 45% more range and the same battery drain. Press Y / R3 or hold the torch on touch to switch. Includes permanent +50% base stamina on top of existing upgrades, hazmat colors and one +5% Stamina/Battery upgrade. Existing owners get focus automatically.

CosmeticEquipment.PreviewDescription: PERMANENT · Choose the color of every glowstick you deploy. Cosmetic only; preview colors on your avatar without buying.
CosmeticEquipment.Name: Glowstick Customizer
CosmeticEquipment.Description: Permanently unlock the glowstick color picker for every glowstick you deploy. Cosmetic only.

Supporter.Name: Zyntra Supporter
Supporter.Description: Receive 10 Research Tokens once and unlock a permanent ZYNTRA SUPPORTER tag.

EntityDetector.PreviewDescription: PERMANENT · Scan nearby threats: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH for 4 seconds. Ready again after 20 seconds. No exact positions, no guaranteed safety.
EntityDetector.Name: Zyntra Entity Detector
EntityDetector.Description: Permanent detector. Press Z / D-pad left or tap SCAN during a run to scan for nearby threats. It reads LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH for 4 seconds and is ready again after 20 seconds. It never shows exact positions and cannot guarantee safety. Free simulated demo in the lobby shop.
